protocol: DrivAerML Surface, 435 training cars, 48 validation cars; four checkpoints (ISLA reference seeds 42/43, GeoTransolver-512 seeds 42/43, 500 epochs, 200,000 cells), float32 inference at 200,000 cells via recipe_globin/src/infer.py under the code_ref snapshot, mirroring kernel/p200k_fleet/p200k_eval_aga.sbatch with +save_predictions=true rescale_geometry=true (kernel/forceref/forceref_aga.sbatch, job 885134). Force coefficient vector = sum over cells of (-Cp n + Cf) A_c w_c with A_ref = 1, Cp = (p - p_inf)/q_inf, Cf = tau/q_inf, q_inf = 0.5 rho |U_inf|^2, n = Mesh.cell_normals (cell winding), w_c = Horvitz-Thompson measure weight (N/k) on the sampled cells and 1 on the full surface; CD along U_inf, CL along z orthogonalized against U_inf, CS completing the triad (forces.build_axis_frame). truth_full: ground truth on all vehicle cells of the full validation mesh; truth_sampled: ground truth on the 200,000 evaluated cells; pred: checkpoint prediction on those cells. Relative errors are |pred - truth| / |truth| per car and the population relative L1/L2 over the 48 cars; correlations are Pearson and Spearman over the 48 cars.
